test: Actual Cocos 3.8.8 WebGL, 21-shot main route, optional second-room stash route, persistent guidance/tool names, audio playback state and mobile touch ownership
method: Real browser frames and DOM mouse/CDP touch input. One explicitly marked DOM TouchEvent fixture checks isolated secondary-finger release, which CDP cannot express. A read-only after-update observer samples tool labels during actual shots. Game state is read for targeting and assertions, never rewritten to reach a room, reward or victory.

knownDiagnostics.message: Ignored attempt to cancel a touchcancel event with cancelable=false, for example because scrolling is in progress and cannot be interrupted.
knownDiagnostics.reason: Official Cocos 3.8.8 web adapter calls preventDefault on our deliberately dispatched non-cancelable native touchcancel; Chromium ignores that no-op.

provenance.note: Original CI result with provenance appended. Eleven of eighteen actual screenshots retained; original archive digest verified. Main 21-shot five-room route and independent eight-shot second-room optional-stash branch use actual DOM input. The full two-stash 23-shot route is covered by core tests, not claimed as a complete browser run. SwiftShader is software WebGL, not physical-phone or WeChat validation; audio was decoded and scheduled, not heard by a human.
